title: Symbolic World Models
hook: Symbolic World Models explores how systems preserve meaning as situations change.
readerPromise: The proposal makes situations, their supporting reasons and verified effects explicit so understanding can continue and be revised.
distinctiveContribution: The proposal makes situations, their supporting reasons and verified effects explicit so understanding can continue and be revised.
visualPlan: Open the source-inspired book motif beside distinct Situation, Reasons and Effects objects. Connect the three semantic roles, without treating a relationship as an execution instruction. Reveal a question marker over the links, inviting inspection of what supports an answer.

Reveal a Friday calendar, a train and the meeting it might affect. Reveal a smaller abstract relationship pattern beneath the particular trip. Trace the arrival-to-meeting dependency and reveal May conflict, preserving the conditional claim.

Reveal two separate evidence routes to one supported conclusion. Withdraw the first route and mark its premise corrected, keeping the other route visible. Emphasize the surviving connection and the question What still supports it?

Reveal a room with separately identified Observation and Prediction thermometers. Draw the command toward the heater, with a pending confirmation symbol rather than a success check. Connect the example to the three abstract roles Interpret, Reason and Verify.
Return to the source-inspired book while retaining one visible justification link. Reveal three selected chapter landmarks, explicitly a reading route rather than the full contents.

independentReview.reviewer: Active LLM, separate complete-script/source review pass; no independent human or second agent claimed.
independentReview.scope: Source support, book identity, narrative continuity, examples-to-concepts balance and bounded reader invitation.
